stem:
Farhan fills a tall plastic bottle with water and closes the cap. He then makes a small hole in the side wall of the bottle, near the bottom.

What does he observe, and what does it show about the pressure exerted by the water?

options.text: Water flows out through the hole, showing that water also pushes on the side walls of the bottle.
No water comes out, showing that water pushes only downward on the bottom of the bottle.
No water comes out, because the closed cap stops water from pushing on the side wall.
Water flows out through the hole, showing that water pushes on the side walls only near the bottom.

teacher.key_rationale: Water flows from a side hole because liquid pressure acts on the side walls, not only downward. B judges from water sitting on the bottom. C treats the closed cap as cancelling side-wall pressure. D over-limits the side-wall rule to the bottom only.
